readback_contract_scope: First-failure capture/report keeps its existing mandatory IO; absent-range guards add bounded zero reads.

parameters: run:Explicitly run one N71 clock/reset diagnostic at probe (bool)
enumerate:Also train WLAN1 and read identity, without DMA or radio (bool)
config_inventory:Read bounded endpoint config after enumeration; no BAR sizing (bool)
host_scan:Temporarily scan with PCI core; size/restore BARs, no binding or DMA (bool)
scan_pme_disable:Opt-in endpoint PME_ENABLE disable/restore for host_scan; no W1C (bool)
scan_hold:Keep the PME host scan and its owners until action=cleanup; no bind or DMA (bool)
bar_sizing:Size/restore endpoint BARs directly; no PCI devices, MMIO or DMA (bool)
chip_id:Size BAR0 and read ChipCommon ID once; temporary route, no DMA or radio (bool)
dart_observe:Read two stable DART snapshots; no provider, DART writes, DMA or IRQ (bool)
dart_cycle:Test temporary DART provider and restore tables; no DMA attachment (bool)
action:assign allocates the held bus; cleanup retries restoration; neither repeats scan
status:Inspect retained ownership and cleanup errors before normal unload
held:Read live bus ownership; distinct from pending restoration
resources:Read assignment and pending ownership; a removed bus is never assigned
